documentation.interpretation: Documented UniProt field convention, not independent validation of an Ensembl object or an experimental identity.

sources.supports: EnsemblFungi resource identifier, first optional field and second optional field denote transcript, protein and gene roles respectively; one string may occupy several roles.
sources.title: UniProt Knowledgebase User Manual

sources.supports: The first DR attribute becomes the cross-reference model ID; subsequent attributes become database-defined properties.
sources.title: UniProt Core DR converter

sources.supports: The model ID serializes as JSON id; named property keys and values remain distinct. The test uses Ensembl, not a biological PHI-base example.
sources.title: UniProt Core JSON cross-reference serialization tests

limitations: Roles describe fields in the pinned UniProt reference, not verified experimental subjects.
Current documentation is applied to historical metadata; no live Ensembl object lookup or current-release validation of the 23 references is claimed.
Roles can overlap for the same string. Gene annotation membership is retained separately.
No identifier spelling, version, namespace or source-owned review is changed.
Rejected references remain rejected, including when their field roles are known.
No new gene, allele, genome, sequence, variant, phenotype or measurement is assigned.
Empty source values remain empty; none are filled from related reference properties.
